name: Panera Scrambled Egg & Aged White Cheddar on Brioche (Plain)
whyItWorks: Freshly scrambled egg and aged white cheddar on a soft brioche roll. Avoids bacon grease, sausage patties, and spicy garlic aiolis for a gentle morning breakfast.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Scrambled Egg & Cheese on Brioche—plain, NO bacon, NO sausage, NO garlic aioli.' Toast lightly.
